{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
initial_rows = len(df)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
filtered_rows = len(df)

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
final_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Initial number of rows: {initial_rows}')
print(f'Rows after filtering QC failures: {filtered_rows}')
print(f'Final number of unique patients: {final_patients}')"}
